title: My AI Tools
subtitle: Every AI connection the team has access to, in plain language. Green means it's ready to use. If something needs a dev, it says so.
searchPlaceholder: Find a tool by name, e.g. Guru or Slack…
legendReady: Connected and turned on for the team.
legendNeedsLook: Something's off, or this one needs care before using. Flag it to a dev.
legendTurnedOff: Not in use right now. No harm in leaving it off.
writeWarning: This one changes real project data. Check with a dev lead before turning tools on — most of these should probably stay off unless a specific task needs it.
healthWarning: This connection is having trouble. If you need it and it's not working, flag it to a dev.
turnedOffBody: Turned off for the team right now — nobody can use its tools.
toggleMcp: Turn this connector on or off for the team
notInNamespaceHelp: This MCP server isn't part of any namespace yet, so there's nothing to turn on. Add it to a namespace first.
noToolsDiscovered: No tools have been discovered for this server yet.
emptyServers: No MCP servers yet. Add one to manage which tools AI can use.
